purpose: Validate the SCB housing-stock layer used as the current-stock baseline in housing analysis.
requiredChecks: latest housing-stock year is explicit and common to all five municipalities
every municipality has exactly one row for each dwelling-type x tenure combination
all dwelling counts are finite and nonnegative
FA total is reproducibly equal to the sum of the five municipal stocks
governance: Housing stock is descriptive production support, not a demographic forecast driver.
Unknown tenure remains explicit as 'uppgift saknas' rather than being redistributed.
Any new SCB classification must be handled explicitly before publication.
